script_text: Leo, the cosmos flipped a switch — this week rewrites your story. Monday, the Sun enters your 1st House in Leo, igniting your fire sign identity with raw confidence. Tuesday, Mercury in Cancer sextiles your natal Sun, sharpening personal communication. Wednesday, Mars squares Saturn in Pisces, creating frustrating delays that test your patience. Thursday shifts everything when Venus enters your 7th House, opening a doorway for love and meaningful partnership. The weekend brings Jupiter trining your natal Sun in the 1st House, flooding your career and public life with unexpected opportunity. Sunday's full moon in Aquarius activates your 10th House, revealing a truth. Thursday is your true power day because Venus enters your 7th House and activates love. Wednesday is your worst day because Mars squares Saturn in Pisces, blocking all momentum. Use Wednesday's tension to plan strategically rather than react emotionally. Follow for daily updates.
